svg.title: Default retraction versus multiple extensions
svg.desc: Exact saved extension model IDs and literal consequences for bird_before, bird_after_penguin and conflicting two_groups. Red denotes retracted default consequences, green new hard-supported consequences, blue shared Bird. These are logical sets, not probability weights.

g.text: Added hard information can retract default conclusions
W0: Bird; Penguin implies Bird and !Fly
The old Fly and !Penguin are retracted, not preserved alongside the new fact.
Both bird cases: bit0=Bird; bit1=Penguin; bit2=Fly. ! = negation.
Conflicting defaults: alternatives are separate extensions
Do not union the alternatives into both Approve and !Approve.
